name: @luraty/dict-ar-en
description: Offline Arabic→English dictionary keyed by @luraty/pack-ar — English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0) and Lane's Lexicon (public domain), machine-extracted, per-source attribution.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:publish
scripts.check:publish: npm run build && publint --strict && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@luraty/dict-ar-en'); if (m.lookup('في').length === 0 || m.sources.length !== 2) process.exit(1)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:publish
